Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Event Coordinator position at your company. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, I bring a practical, hands-on approach to coordinating events and supporting communication activities.

In my current roles, I manage multiple projects simultaneously, from building and maintaining websites to creating content and running SEO campaigns. I am organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with CMS platforms like WordPress, social media, and design tools such as Canva. I have experience coordinating with teams and suppliers, managing deadlines, and ensuring smooth execution of tasks.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, with a willingness to improve. I am eager to learn and contribute to your communication team, ensuring every event is well-prepared and turned into concrete business opportunities.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your events.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Event Coordinator position at your company. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, I bring a practical, hands-on approach to coordinating events and supporting communication activities.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I manage multiple projects simultaneously, from building and maintaining websites to creating content and running SEO campaigns. I am organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with CMS platforms like WordPress, social media, and design tools such as Canva. I have experience coordinating with teams and suppliers, managing deadlines, and ensuring smooth execution of tasks. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits, which required careful planning and attention to detail.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, with a willingness to improve. I am eager to learn and contribute to your communication team, ensuring every event is well-prepared and turned into concrete business opportunities. My technical skills, including basic media production and graphic design, allow me to support event materials and branding effectively.

I am interested in space, science, and technology, and I am excited about the opportunity to bring my skills to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your events.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
